params.name: ClientID
params.description:
22-character <>.
Note: <> will create accountIDs at the same Client level. This is not recommended if you cannot share SubClient and Client accountIDs at the same level.

params.name: RejectDuplicateCard
params.description:
Use to disallow account creation if an account with card already exists

Incompatible with query string `OKToAddDuplicateCard`. All requests must use `RejectDuplicateCard` or `OKToAddDuplicateCard` if using [Duplicate Card Check](https://developers.tabapay.com/reference/how-to-use-duplicate-card-check#).
Use is allowed if <<glossary:Version>> is `v1` (not `v2`)

params.name: OKToAddDuplicateCard
params.description:
Use to allow account creation if an account with card already exists

Incompatible with query string `RejectDuplicateCard`. All requests must use `OKToAddDuplicateCard` or `RejectDuplicateCard` if using [Duplicate Card Check](https://developers.tabapay.com/reference/how-to-use-duplicate-card-check#/).
Use is allowed if <<glossary:Version>> is `v1` (not `v2`)
